cards.name: Wisp
cards.flavorText: If you hit an Eredar Lord with enough Wisps, it will explode. But why?

cards.name: Abusive Sergeant
cards.text: Battlecry: Give a minion +2 Attack this turn.
cards.flavorText: ADD ME TO YOUR DECK, MAGGOT!

cards.name: Angry Chicken
cards.flavorText: There is no beast more frightening (or ridiculous) than a fully enraged chicken.

cards.name: Argent Squire
cards.flavorText: "I solemnly swear to uphold the Light, purge the world of darkness, and to eat only burritos." - The Argent Dawn Oath

cards.name: Bloodsail Corsair
cards.text: Battlecry: Remove 1 Durability from your opponent's weapon.
cards.flavorText: Every pirate uses the same four digits to access Automated Gold Dispensers. It's called the "Pirate's Code".

cards.name: Elven Archer
cards.flavorText: Don't bother asking her out on a date. She'll shoot you down.

cards.name: Emerald Skytalon
cards.flavorText: Sworn protectors of Ysera at the Emerald Dragonshrine, these majestic owls have been touched by the powers of the Emerald Dream, taking on an almost crystalline appearance.

cards.name: Goldshire Footman
cards.flavorText: If 1/2 minions are all that is defending Goldshire, you would think it would have been overrun years ago.

cards.name: Grimscale Oracle
cards.flavorText: These are the brainy murlocs. It turns out that doesn’t mean much.

cards.name: Hungry Crab
cards.flavorText: Murloc. It's what's for dinner.

cards.name: Leper Gnome
cards.text: Deathrattle: Deal 2 damage to the enemy hero.
cards.flavorText: He really just wants to be your friend, but the constant rejection is starting to really get to him.

cards.name: Lightwarden
cards.text: Whenever a character is healed, gain +2 Attack.
cards.flavorText: She’s smaller than her sisters Mediumwarden and Heavywarden.

cards.name: Murloc Raider
cards.flavorText: Mrrraggglhlhghghlgh, mrgaaag blarrghlgaahahl mrgggg glhalhah a bghhll graggmgmg Garrosh mglhlhlh mrghlhlhl!!

cards.name: Murloc Tidecaller
cards.text: Whenever you summon a Murloc, gain +1 Attack.
cards.flavorText: This guy gets crazy strong at family reunions.

cards.name: Secretkeeper
cards.flavorText: Where is Mankrik’s wife? She’ll never tell.

cards.name: Shieldbearer
cards.flavorText: Have you seen the size of the shields in this game?? This is no easy job.

cards.name: Southsea Deckhand
cards.text: Has Charge while you have a weapon equipped.
cards.flavorText: Pirates are into this new fad called "Planking".

cards.name: Stonetusk Boar
cards.flavorText: This card is boaring.

cards.name: Voodoo Doctor
cards.flavorText: Voodoo is an oft-misunderstood art. But it is art.

cards.name: Worgen Infiltrator
cards.flavorText: If you want to stop a worgen from infiltrating, just yell, "No! Bad boy!"

cards.name: Young Dragonhawk
cards.flavorText: They were the inspiration for the championship Taurenball team: The Dragonhawks.

cards.name: Young Priestess
cards.text: At the end of your turn, give another random friendly minion +1 Health.
cards.flavorText: She can't wait to learn Power Word: Fortitude Rank 2.

cards.name: Acidic Swamp Ooze
cards.flavorText: Oozes love Flamenco. Don't ask.

cards.name: Amani Berserker
cards.flavorText: If an Amani berserker asks "Joo lookin' at me?!", the correct response is "Nah, mon".

cards.name: Ancient Watcher
cards.flavorText: Why do its eyes seem to follow you as you walk by?

cards.name: Bloodfen Raptor
cards.flavorText: "Kill 30 raptors." - Hemet Nesingwary

cards.name: Bloodmage Thalnos
cards.flavorText: He's in charge of the Annual Scarlet Monastery Blood Drive!

cards.name: Bloodsail Raider
cards.text: Battlecry: Gain Attack equal to the Attack of your weapon.
cards.flavorText: "I only plunder on days that end in 'y'."

cards.name: Bluegill Warrior
cards.flavorText: He just wants a hug. A sloppy... slimy... hug.

cards.name: Captain's Parrot
cards.text: Battlecry: Draw a Pirate from your deck.
cards.flavorText: Pirates and Parrots go together like Virmen and Carrots.

cards.name: Crazed Alchemist
cards.text: Battlecry: Swap the Attack and Health of a minion.
cards.flavorText: "You'll love my new recipe!" he says... especially if you're not happy with your current number of limbs.

cards.name: Dire Wolf Alpha
cards.flavorText: We are pretty excited about the upcoming release of Dire Wolf Beta, just repost this sign for a chance at a key.

cards.name: Doomsayer
cards.text: At the start of your turn, destroy ALL minions.
cards.flavorText: He's almost been right so many times. He was sure it was coming during the Cataclysm.

cards.name: Faerie Dragon
cards.flavorText: Adorable. Immune to Magic. Doesn't pee on the rug. The perfect pet!

cards.name: Frostwolf Grunt
cards.flavorText: Grunting is what his father did and his father before that. It's more than just a job.

cards.name: Knife Juggler
cards.text: After you summon a minion, deal 1 damage to a random enemy.
cards.flavorText: Ambitious Knife Jugglers sometimes graduate to Bomb Jugglers. They never last long enough to make it onto a card though.

cards.name: Kobold Geomancer
cards.flavorText: In the old days, Kobolds were the finest candle merchants in the land. Then they got pushed too far...

cards.name: Loot Hoarder
cards.flavorText: Always roll need.

cards.name: Lorewalker Cho
cards.text: Whenever a player casts a spell, put a copy into the other player’s hand.
cards.flavorText: Lorewalker Cho archives and shares tales from the land of Pandaria, but his favorite story is the one where Joey and Phoebe go on a road trip.

cards.name: Mad Bomber
cards.text: Battlecry: Deal 3 damage randomly split between all other characters.
cards.flavorText: He's not really all that crazy, he is just not as careful with explosives as he should be.

cards.name: Mana Addict
cards.text: Whenever you cast a spell, gain +2 Attack this turn.
cards.flavorText: She’s trying to kick the habit, but still takes some mana whenever she has a stressful day.

cards.name: Mana Wraith
cards.flavorText: They come out at night to eat leftover mana crystals. "Mmmmmm," they say.

cards.name: Master Swordsmith
cards.text: At the end of your turn, give another random friendly minion +1 Attack.
cards.flavorText: He's currently trying to craft a "flail-axe", but all the other swordsmiths say it can't be done.

cards.name: Millhouse Manastorm
cards.flavorText: "I'm gonna light you up, sweetcheeks!"

cards.name: Murloc Tidehunter
cards.flavorText: "Death will rise, from the tides!"

cards.name: Nat Pagle
cards.text: At the start of your turn, you have a 50% chance to draw an extra card.
cards.flavorText: Nat Pagle, Azeroth's premier fisherman! He invented the Auto-Angler 3000, the Extendo-Pole 3000, and the Lure-o-matic 2099 (still in testing).

cards.name: Novice Engineer
cards.flavorText: "Half of this class will not graduate… since they'll have been turned to chickens." - Tinkmaster Overspark, teaching Gizmos 101.

cards.name: Pint-Sized Summoner
cards.text: The first minion you play each turn costs (1) less.
cards.flavorText: She's quite jealous of the Gallon-Sized Summoner.

cards.name: River Crocolisk
cards.flavorText: Edward "Lefty" Smith tried to make luggage out of a river crocolisk once.

cards.name: Sunfury Protector
cards.flavorText: She carries a shield, but only so she can give it to someone she can stand behind.

cards.name: Wild Pyromancer
cards.text: After you cast a spell, deal 1 damage to ALL minions.
cards.flavorText: BOOM BABY BOOM! BAD IS GOOD! DOWN WITH GOVERNMENT!

cards.name: Youthful Brewmaster
cards.text: Battlecry: Return a friendly minion from the battlefield to your hand.
cards.flavorText: His youthful enthusiasm doesn’t always equal excellence in his brews. Don’t drink the Mogu Stout!

cards.name: Acolyte of Pain
cards.text: Whenever this minion takes damage, draw a card.
cards.flavorText: He trained when he was younger to be an acolyte of joy, but things didn’t work out like he thought they would.

cards.name: Alarm-o-Bot
cards.text: At the start of your turn, swap this minion with a random one in your hand.
cards.flavorText: WARNING. WARNING. WARNING.

cards.name: Arcane Golem
cards.text: Charge. Battlecry: Give your opponent a Mana Crystal.
cards.flavorText: Having Arcane golems at home really classes up the place, and as a bonus they are great conversation pieces.

cards.name: Blood Knight
cards.text: Battlecry: All minions lose Divine Shield. Gain +3/+3 for each Shield lost.
cards.flavorText: The Blood Knights get their holy powers from the Sunwell, which you should NOT bathe in.

cards.name: Brightwing
cards.text: Battlecry: Add a random Legendary minion to your hand.
cards.flavorText: Little faerie dragons are made of sugar and spice and maniacal vice.

cards.name: Coldlight Oracle
cards.flavorText: They can see the future. In that future both players draw more cards. Spoooky.

cards.name: Coldlight Seer
cards.flavorText: The Coldlight murlocs reside in the darkest pits of the Abyssal Depths. So no, there's no getting away from murlocs.

cards.name: Dalaran Mage
cards.flavorText: You don't see a lot of Dalaran warriors.

cards.name: Demolisher
cards.text: At the start of your turn, deal 2 damage to a random enemy.
cards.flavorText: Laying siege isn't fun for anyone. It's not even all that effective, now that everyone has a flying mount.

cards.name: Earthen Ring Farseer
cards.flavorText: He can see really far, and he doesn't use a telescope like those filthy pirates.

cards.name: Emperor Cobra
cards.flavorText: The Sholazar Basin is home to a lot of really horrible things. If you're going to visit, wear bug spray. And plate armor.

cards.name: Flesheating Ghoul
cards.text: Whenever a minion dies, gain +1 Attack.
cards.flavorText: 'Flesheating' is an unfair name. It's just that there's not really much else for him to eat.

cards.name: Harvest Golem
cards.flavorText: "Overheat threshold exceeded. System failure. Wheat clog in port two. Shutting down."

cards.name: Imp Master
cards.text: At the end of your turn, deal 1 damage to this minion and summon a 1/1 Imp.
cards.flavorText: She would enjoy the job a lot more if she just could get the imps to QUIT BITING HER.

cards.name: Injured Blademaster
cards.flavorText: He claims it is an old war wound, but we think he just cut himself shaving.

cards.name: Ironbeak Owl
cards.flavorText: Their wings are silent but their screech is... whatever the opposite of silent is.

cards.name: Ironforge Rifleman
cards.flavorText: "Ready! Aim! Drink!"

cards.name: Ironfur Grizzly
cards.flavorText: "Bear Carcass 1/10"

cards.name: Jungle Panther
cards.flavorText: Stranglethorn is a beautiful place to visit, but you wouldn't want to live there.

cards.name: King Mukla
cards.flavorText: King Mukla wanders Jaguero Isle, searching for love.

cards.name: Magma Rager
cards.flavorText: He likes to think he is powerful, but pretty much anyone can solo Molten Core now.

cards.name: Murloc Warleader
cards.flavorText: Do Murlocs ever get tired of making the same old sound? Nope! Mrglglrglglglglglglgl!

cards.name: Questing Adventurer
cards.text: Whenever you play a card, gain +1/+1.
cards.flavorText: "Does anyone have some extra Boar Pelts?"

cards.name: Raging Worgen
cards.flavorText: If he's raging now, just wait until he gets nerfed.

cards.name: Raid Leader
cards.flavorText: "That's a 50 DKP minus!"

cards.name: Razorfen Hunter
cards.flavorText: Someone did mess with Tuskerr once. ONCE.

cards.name: Scarlet Crusader
cards.flavorText: Never wash your whites with a Scarlet Crusader.

cards.name: Shattered Sun Cleric
cards.flavorText: They always have a spare flask of Sunwell Energy Drink™!

cards.name: Silverback Patriarch
cards.flavorText: He likes to act like he's in charge, but the silverback matriarch actually runs things.

cards.name: Southsea Captain
cards.flavorText: When he saves enough plunder, he's going to commission an enormous captain's hat. He has hat envy.

cards.name: Tauren Warrior
cards.flavorText: Tauren Warrior: Champion of Mulgore, Slayer of Quilboar, Rider of Thunderbluff Elevators.

cards.name: Thrallmar Farseer
cards.flavorText: He's stationed in the Hellfire Peninsula, but he's hoping for a reassignment closer to Orgrimmar, or really anywhere the ground is less on fire.

cards.name: Tinkmaster Overspark
cards.text: Battlecry: Transform another random minion into a 5/5 Devilsaur or a 1/1 Squirrel.
cards.flavorText: Tinkmaster Overspark nearly lost his Tinker's license after the Great Ironforge Squirrel Stampede of '09.

cards.name: Wolfrider
cards.flavorText: Orcish raiders ride wolves because they are well adapted to harsh environments, and because they are soft and cuddly.

cards.name: Ancient Brewmaster
cards.text: Battlecry: Return a friendly minion from the battlefield to your hand.
cards.flavorText: Most pandaren say his brew tastes like yak. But apparently that's a compliment.

cards.name: Ancient Mage
cards.flavorText: Sometimes he forgets and just wanders into someone else's game.

cards.name: Big Game Hunter
cards.text: Tradeable Battlecry: Destroy a minion with 7 or more Attack.
cards.flavorText: Mere devilsaurs no longer excite him. Soon he'll be trying to catch Onyxia with only a dull Krol Blade.

cards.name: Chillwind Yeti
cards.flavorText: He always dreamed of coming down from the mountains and opening a noodle shop, but he never got the nerve.

cards.name: Cult Master
cards.text: After a friendly minion dies, draw a card.
cards.flavorText: She may be an evil cult master, but she still calls her parents once a week.

cards.name: Dark Iron Dwarf
cards.text: Battlecry: Give a minion +2 Attack this turn.
cards.flavorText: Guardians of Dark Iron Ore. Perhaps the most annoying ore, given where you have to forge it.

cards.name: Defender of Argus
cards.flavorText: You wouldn’t think that Argus would need this much defending. But it does.

cards.name: Dragonling Mechanic
cards.flavorText: She is still working on installing the rocket launcher add-on for Mr. Bitey.

cards.name: Dread Corsair
cards.text: Taunt Costs (1) less per Attack of your weapon.
cards.flavorText: "Yarrrr" is a pirate word that means "Greetings, milord."

cards.name: Footman
cards.flavorText: Ha ha HAAAH huHAH!

cards.name: Gnomish Inventor
cards.flavorText: She's never quite sure what she's making, she just knows it's AWESOME!

cards.name: Mogu'shan Warden
cards.flavorText: All these guys ever do is talk about the Thunder King. BOOOORRRINNG!

cards.name: Oasis Snapjaw
cards.flavorText: His dreams of flying and breathing fire like his idol will never be realized.

cards.name: Ogre Magi
cards.flavorText: Training Ogres in the art of spellcasting is a questionable decision.

cards.name: Old Murk-Eye
cards.text: Charge. Has +1 Attack for each other Murloc on the battlefield.
cards.flavorText: He's a legend among murlocs. "Mrghllghghllghg!", they say.

cards.name: SI:7 Infiltrator
cards.flavorText: What will she destroy? It’s a secret!

cards.name: Sen'jin Shieldmasta
cards.flavorText: Sen'jin Village is nice, if you like trolls and dust.

cards.name: Silvermoon Guardian
cards.flavorText: The first time they tried to guard Silvermoon against the scourge, it didn’t go so well…

cards.name: Spellbreaker
cards.flavorText: Spellbreakers can rip enchantments from magic-wielders. The process is painless and can be performed on an outpatient basis.

cards.name: Stormwind Knight
cards.flavorText: They're still embarrassed about "The Deathwing Incident".

cards.name: The Black Knight
cards.flavorText: He was sent by the Lich King to disrupt the Argent Tournament. We can pretty much mark that a failure.

cards.name: Twilight Drake
cards.text: Battlecry: Gain +1 Health for each card in your hand.
cards.flavorText: Twilight drakes feed on Mystical Energy. And Tacos.

cards.name: Violet Teacher
cards.text: Whenever you cast a spell, summon a 1/1 Violet Apprentice.
cards.flavorText: If you don't pay attention, you may be turned into a pig. And then you get your name on the board.

cards.name: Abomination
cards.flavorText: Abominations enjoy Fresh Meat and long walks on the beach.

cards.name: Azure Drake
cards.flavorText: They initially planned to be the Beryl or Cerulean drakes, but those felt a tad too pretentious.

cards.name: Booty Bay Bodyguard
cards.flavorText: You can hire him... until someone offers him enough gold to turn on you.

cards.name: Captain Greenskin
cards.flavorText: He was this close to piloting a massive juggernaut into Stormwind Harbor. If it weren't for those pesky kids!

cards.name: Darkscale Healer
cards.text: Battlecry: Restore 2 Health to all friendly characters.
cards.flavorText: Healing is just something she does in her free time. It's more of a hobby really.

cards.name: Elite Tauren Chieftain
cards.text: Battlecry: Give both players the power to ROCK! (with a Power Chord card)
cards.flavorText: He's looking for a drummer. The current candidates are: Novice Engineer, Sen'jin Shieldmasta', and Ragnaros the Firelord.

cards.name: Faceless Manipulator
cards.text: Battlecry: Choose a minion and become a copy of it.
cards.flavorText: The Faceless Ones are servants of Yogg-Saron, and they feed on fear. Right now they are feeding on your fear of accidentally disenchanting all your good cards.

cards.name: Fen Creeper
cards.flavorText: He used to be called Bog Beast, but it confused people because he wasn't an actual beast. Boom, New Name!

cards.name: Frostwolf Warlord
cards.text: Battlecry: Gain +1/+1 for each other friendly minion on the battlefield.
cards.flavorText: The Frostwolves are locked in combat with the Stormpike Expedition over control of Alterac Valley. Every attempt at peace-talks has ended with Captain Galvangar killing the mediator.

cards.name: Gurubashi Berserker
cards.text: Whenever this minion takes damage, gain +3 Attack.
cards.flavorText: No Pain, No Gain.

cards.name: Harrison Jones
cards.text: Battlecry: Destroy your opponent's weapon and draw cards equal to its Durability.
cards.flavorText: “That belongs in the Hall of Explorers!”

cards.name: Leeroy Jenkins
cards.text: Charge. Battlecry: Summon two 1/1 Whelps for your opponent.
cards.flavorText: At least he has Angry Chicken.

cards.name: Mind Control Tech
cards.text: Battlecry: If your opponent has 4 or more minions, take control of one.
cards.flavorText: Mind Control technology is getting better, but that's not saying much.

cards.name: Night Elf Huntress
cards.text: Battlecry: Deal 3 damage to three different enemies. (You pick the targets!)
cards.flavorText: A triple threat, all on her own.

cards.name: Nightblade
cards.flavorText: Your face is the place you'd probably least like a dagger, and where rogues are most likely to deliver them.

cards.name: Silver Hand Knight
cards.flavorText: It's good to be a knight. Less so to be one's squire.

cards.name: Spiteful Smith
cards.text: Your weapon has +2 Attack while this is damaged.
cards.flavorText: She'll craft you a sword, but you'll need to bring her 5 Steel Ingots, 3 Motes of Earth, and the scalp of her last customer.

cards.name: Stampeding Kodo
cards.text: Battlecry: Destroy a random enemy minion with 2 or less Attack.
cards.flavorText: This Kodo is so big that he can stampede by himself.

cards.name: Stormpike Commando
cards.flavorText: The Stormpike Commandos are demolition experts. They also bake a mean cupcake.

cards.name: Stranglethorn Tiger
cards.flavorText: The wonderful thing about tigers is tigers are wonderful things!

cards.name: Venture Co. Mercenary
cards.flavorText: No Job is too big. No fee is too big.

cards.name: Warsong Grunt
cards.text: Rush. After this attacks and kills a minion, it may attack again.
cards.flavorText: Where do you think the chickens learned to be angry?

cards.name: Archmage
cards.flavorText: You earn the title of Archmage when you can destroy anyone who calls you on it.

cards.name: Argent Commander
cards.flavorText: The Argent Dawn stands vigilant against the Scourge, as well as people who cut in line at coffee shops.

cards.name: Boulderfist Ogre
cards.flavorText: "ME HAVE GOOD STATS FOR THE COST"

cards.name: Cairne Bloodhoof
cards.flavorText: Cairne was killed by Garrosh, so... don't put this guy in a Warrior deck. It's pretty insensitive.

cards.name: Frost Elemental
cards.flavorText: When a Water elemental and an Ice elemental love each other VERY much...

cards.name: Gelbin Mekkatorque
cards.flavorText: He's the leader of the gnomes, and an incredible inventor. He's getting better, too; He turns things into chickens WAY less than he used to.

cards.name: Gnomelia, S.A.F.E. Pilot
cards.text: Rush. Also damages minions next to whomever this attacks. Deathrattle: Deal 2 damage to all enemies.
cards.flavorText: Never learned how to L.A.N.D.

cards.name: Harth Stonebrew
cards.text: Battlecry: Replace your hand with an iconic one from Hearthstone's past. (Once per game)
cards.flavorText: "Grab a slice by the hearth and enjoy the festivities. This celebration is for all of us!" -Harth

cards.name: High Inquisitor Whitemane
cards.text: Battlecry: Summon all friendly minions that died this turn.
cards.flavorText: No one told her that champions want to sleep in.

cards.name: Hogger
cards.text: At the end of your turn, summon a 2/2 Gnoll with Taunt.
cards.flavorText: Hogger is super powerful. If you kill him, it's because he let you.

cards.name: Lord of the Arena
cards.flavorText: He used to be a 2100+ rated arena player, but that was years ago and nobody can get him to shut up about it.

cards.name: Priestess of Elune
cards.flavorText: If she threatens to "moon" you, it's not what you think.

cards.name: Reckless Rocketeer
cards.flavorText: One Insane Rocketeer. One Rocket full of Explosives. Infinite Fun.

cards.name: Sunwalker
cards.flavorText: She doesn’t ACTUALLY walk on the Sun. It's just a name. Don’t worry!

cards.name: Sylvanas Windrunner
cards.text: Deathrattle: Take control of a random enemy minion.
cards.flavorText: Sylvanas was turned into the Banshee Queen by Arthas, but he probably should have just killed her because it just pissed her off.

cards.name: The Beast
cards.text: Deathrattle: Summon a 3/3 Pip Quickwit for your opponent.
cards.flavorText: He lives in Blackrock Mountain. He eats Gnomes. That's pretty much it.

cards.name: Windfury Harpy
cards.flavorText: Harpies are not pleasant sounding. That's the nicest I can put it.

cards.name: Xavius
cards.text: After you play a card, summon a 2/1 Satyr.
cards.flavorText: Xavius has grand nightmares of summoning Sargeras into this world, but a few Satyr will have to do for now.

cards.name: Baron Geddon
cards.text: At the end of your turn, deal 2 damage to ALL other characters.
cards.flavorText: Baron Geddon was Ragnaros's foremost lieutenant, until he got FIRED.

cards.name: Barrens Stablehand
cards.flavorText: It’s never Huffer.

cards.name: Core Hound
cards.flavorText: You don’t tame a Core Hound. You just train it to eat someone else before it eats you.

cards.name: Gadgetzan Auctioneer
cards.text: Whenever you cast a spell, draw a card.
cards.flavorText: He used to run the black market auction house, but there was just too much violence and he had to move.

cards.name: Ravenholdt Assassin
cards.flavorText: Just mail him a package with a name and 10,000 gold. He'll take care of the rest.

cards.name: Stormwind Champion
cards.flavorText: When Deathwing assaulted the capital, this soldier was the only member of his squad to survive. Now he's all bitter and stuff.

cards.name: War Golem
cards.flavorText: Golems are not afraid, but for some reason they still run when you cast Fear on them. Instinct, maybe? A desire to blend in?

cards.name: Arcane Devourer
cards.text: Whenever you cast a spell, gain +2/+2.
cards.flavorText: Likes her magic with a pinch of salt.

cards.name: Gruul
cards.text: At the end of each turn, gain +1/+1 .
cards.flavorText: He's Gruul "the Dragonkiller". He just wanted to cuddle them… he never meant to…

cards.name: Ragnaros the Firelord
cards.text: Can't attack. At the end of your turn, deal 8 damage to a random enemy.
cards.flavorText: Ragnaros was summoned by the Dark Iron dwarves, who were eventually enslaved by the Firelord. Summoning Ragnaros often doesn’t work out the way you want it to.

cards.name: Alexstrasza
cards.text: Battlecry: Set a hero's remaining Health to 15.
cards.flavorText: Alexstrasza the Life-Binder brings life and hope to everyone. Except Deathwing. And Malygos. And Nekros.

cards.name: Alexstrasza the Life-Binder
cards.text: Battlecry: Choose a character. If it's friendly, restore 8 Health. If it's an enemy, deal 8 damage.
cards.flavorText: Friendly Fire: Off

cards.name: Malygos
cards.flavorText: Malygos hates it when mortals use magic. He gets so mad!

cards.name: Malygos the Spellweaver
cards.text: Battlecry: Draw spells until your hand is full.
cards.flavorText: After many years, Malygos has decided mortals can use magic. ALL THE MAGIC!

cards.name: Nozdormu
cards.text: Players only have 15 seconds to take their turns.
cards.flavorText: Time to write some flavor text.

cards.name: Onyxia
cards.text: Battlecry: Summon 1/1 Whelps until your side of the battlefield is full.
cards.flavorText: Onyxia long manipulated the Stormwind Court by disguising herself as Lady Katrana Prestor. You would have thought that the giant wings and scales would have been a giveaway.

cards.name: Onyxia the Broodmother
cards.text: At the end of each turn, fill your board with 1/1 Whelps.
cards.flavorText: Throw more dots, throw more dots, more dots, more dots!

cards.name: Ysera
cards.text: At the end of your turn, get two random Dream cards.
cards.flavorText: Ysera rules the Emerald Dream. Which is some kind of green-mirror-version of the real world, or something?

cards.name: Ysera the Dreamer
cards.text: Battlecry: Add one of each Dream card to your hand.
cards.flavorText: Quick! Quick! Write it down before you forget them all!

cards.name: Deathwing
cards.text: Battlecry: Destroy all other minions and discard your hand.
cards.flavorText: Once a noble dragon known as Neltharion, Deathwing lost his mind and shattered Azeroth before finally being defeated. Daddy issues?

cards.name: Deathwing the Destroyer
cards.text: Battlecry: Destroy all other minions. Discard a card for each destroyed.
cards.flavorText: "He’s Deathwing? That one's Deathwing? You're Deathwing!? I'm DEATHWING! ARE THERE ANY OTHER DEATHWINGS I SHOULD KNOW ABOUT?"

cards.name: Sea Giant
cards.text: Costs (1) less for each other minion on the battlefield.
cards.flavorText: See? Giant.

cards.name: Mountain Giant
cards.text: Costs (1) less for each other card in your hand.
cards.flavorText: His mother said that he was just big boned.

cards.name: Molten Giant
